gaps.detail: Redirected to Google sign-in; no public 1.12 resources extracted.
Major Distribution 1.8 was not imported in this pass. Four direct script-menu archives are already preserved.
Several older mirrors require subscriber/unlock gates; the separate OneDrive share was not tested. Existing v2 stays intact.
Official free file is v1.1 already archived. Paid v1.3/v1.5 labels must not be applied to the free archive.
Four OLD components have no complete distribution/version proof. Original references retained; no older archive files deleted.
A 109,460,896-byte NPEB00882 package is explicitly under Test. It was not promoted to a verified release or added to this bounded eight-job batch.

readme.summary: The author distinguishes disc/ISO common.rpf from PSN common.edat. Ready EDAT alternatives are supplied for NPEB00882 and NPUB30702 and the installation copy must be named common.edat. Other visuals depend on the corresponding RPF/IMG/XML/CTD files and the installed title ID. A note says a 1.1 update is no longer mandatory, but does not unambiguously identify a game title-update version.
